title: ZZZ's at Seagrove - 30A Five Star Properties
description_expanded:
ZZZ's at Seagrove Highlights:

🌴 Private Pool — Relax and unwind after a beach day in your own private pool. Optional pool heat available October–March for $65/day with 48-hour notice. 🏖️ Easy Beach Access — Just a 3-minute walk to the beach, so you can be on the sand in minutes. Beach access is fully reopened and ready for guests. 🚗 6-Seater Golf Cart Included — Cruise to the beach, shops, and restaurants with ease. 🛏️ Three King Master Suites — Spacious suites with king beds, perfect for couples or families wanting comfort and privacy. ☀️ Beach Gear & Towels Provided — Pack lighter and enjoy everything you need for a beach day. 🍔 Outdoor Entertaining Area + Grill — Great for cookouts, family dinners, and relaxing evenings by the pool.

This is it—the home you’ve been searching for! Welcome to ZZZ's at Seagrove, a luxurious 4-bedroom Mediterranean villa nestled in a private, gated enclave. Surrounded by a lush tropical paradise and just steps from the beach, this home offers the perfect blend of Old World charm and modern elegance.

SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:

SECOND FLOOR:

- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub - Guest Bedroom: Two Queen Beds with Twin bunk beds & Private Bathroom with Shower

THIRD FLOOR: - Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower - Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower - Upstairs Living Room: Queen Sleeper Sofa

Experience the ultimate luxury beach getaway at ZZZ’s at Seagrove. Whether you’re here to relax by the private pool, explore 30A’s stunning coastline, or enjoy world-class dining and shopping, this villa offers everything you need for an unforgettable stay!

Check-In: A keypad is available 24 hours a day to provide entry for guests
